# `/custom-password-instructions` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /custom-password-instructions/v1

`createCustomPasswordInstructionsV1` — Create custom password instructions — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API creates the custom password instructions for the specified page ID. The `pageId` determines which login and password-recovery screen your custom instructions appear on. The following table describes each supported page ID and where its text is displayed: | Page ID | Where the custom text appears | | --- | --- | | `flow-selection:select` | Flow-selection landing screen, under "Need help signing in?", above the navigation links. | | `reset-password:enter-username` | Reset-password…

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): custompasswordinstruction
- Returns 200: custompasswordinstruction

### GET /custom-password-instructions/v1/{pageId}

`getCustomPasswordInstructionsV1` — Get custom password instructions by page id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the custom password instructions for the specified page ID.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pageId` (path, required) — one of change-password:enter-password, change-password:finish, flow-selection:select, forget-username:user-email, mfa:enter-code, mfa:enter-kba, mfa:select, reset-password:enter-password, reset-password:enter-username, reset-password:finish, unlock-account:enter-username, unlock-account:finish — The page ID of custom password instructions to query.
  - `locale` (query) — The locale for the custom instructions, a BCP47 language tag. The default value is \"default\".
- Returns 200: custompasswordinstruction

### DELETE /custom-password-instructions/v1/{pageId}

`deleteCustomPasswordInstructionsV1` — Delete custom password instructions by page id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API delete the custom password instructions for the specified page ID.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `pageId` (path, required) — one of change-password:enter-password, change-password:finish, flow-selection:select, forget-username:user-email, mfa:enter-code, mfa:enter-kba, mfa:select, reset-password:enter-password, reset-password:enter-username, reset-password:finish, unlock-account:enter-username, unlock-account:finish — The page ID of custom password instructions to delete.
  - `locale` (query) — The locale for the custom instructions, a BCP47 language tag. The default value is \"default\".
- Returns 204: no body
